![cad final](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/zahO6dkL9DH8QSRTlhcB47kiamCkrzS8/87817bb0d34ccdb8e5d21b927e011d39b152daab2d03c76b977df7c524454874.jpg)

Worked on the CAD model of the keyboard in Fusion 360, and it was truly a hustle 😭. I spent around 40–50 minutes trying out things on my own, but I had a rough time doing so. Shaping the bottom and designing and arranging the switches was really tough for me, as I'm a total beginner in Fusion 360.
So, I had to take help from a friend who knew Fusion 360 well. He helped me design it.
It was challenging, but we completed it in the end.

![cad2](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/zahO6dkL9DH8QSRTlhcB47kiamCkrzS8/adfcb6b2c21a8dc9f6c3e0f602a0222eef3d04ce8d62e87a7979bf161dbe5f76.jpg)

### 2026-10-11 – Worked on the firmware for the split keyboard…. It was quite tiring, and the code and logic were mind-bending…because I needed to make sure that all the parts worked together nicely and that the forma

**1.67h**

Worked on the firmware for the split keyboard…. It was quite tiring, and the code and logic were mind-bending…because I needed to make sure that all the parts worked together nicely and that the format supported all the elements used in the PCB I had designed…..
Improved it with the help of AI.
So now, the firmware is done too!
